title: Fresh-TVL cluster (10 fresh 2026 deployments, $2.87M-$8.94M each) — fork-drift / config-rot / rate-provider deep dive
closed_reasons: NaraUSD: mint and redeem are Keyring-credential-gated (hasValidCredentials(fresh)=false, fork-proven KeyringCredentialInvalid); parity is exact 1:1 with zero fees and no oracle in the path; instant-redeem collateral is only $2,958.50; all MCT/admin roles are Safe-held

SUBFROST (ETH side): every fund-moving selector is onlyAuth (BIP340 FROST), onlyVault (immutable), or owner-to-vault; garbage/flipped signatures revert from a live relayer; replay guards (authNonce + usedBridgeNonce) live; depositAndBridge is public but one-way

up v3: CLPool byte-identical (metadata-stripped) to audited aerodrome-finance/slipstream; NPM source == upstream; fee modules byte-identical; gauge auth canonical; fork-proven NNFT/F0/NA negatives; M-03 cap-mode bypass not armed (capMode==pendingCapMode==2)

Scorch: router instruction surface is swap/swap2022 only (IDL + 35-tx census, all user-signed); vault PDA-owned accounts can only move against a user in-side transfer; no withdraw instruction exists (core pricing internals unverifiable -> medium confidence)
Icarus CL: verified sources at every layer, auth canonical for the generation (NNFT/NA/F0 fork-proven); gauge registered but unfunded (rewardRate=0); NPM ETH balance 0

HertzFlow: wrapped-bank parity exact (reserves >= supply); bank mint is permissioned (isMintCaller) and mints only un-synced surplus to a whitelisted DepositVault; redeem is caller-scoped; makeExternalCalls is permissionless but the executor holds no RoleStore roles (DataStore writes revert Unauthorized)

Longbow: the 16 unverified pool feeds are 300-second Uniswap V3 TWAPs (fork-proven +54% same-tx slot0 move -> 0 bp feed move); Loopback oracle is floor/cap clamped; 37 equity markets ride operator-driven Chainlink proxies; singleton idle liquidity ~$115k caps borrow-side attacks

Meridian: processActions is onlySequencer; historical batch replay -> NotSequencer (attacker) / ActionAlreadyProcessed (sequencer, monotonic ids); EIP-712 + per-action nonces + expiry + strict ECDSA/ERC-1271; withdrawals enforce the user signature at finalizeWithdraw; merUSD exactly 1:1 backed by USDe

Aero Lite: factory+pool+linked library byte-identical to dromos-labs/metadex-slipstream-public; no gauge/voter/NPM layer exists (voter=0, registry gaugeFactory=0, all pools gauge=0/nft=0); admin negatives fork-proven
Fang: canonical Tomb math (fork-proven -2% round trip), 0/16 fee-on-transfer tokens, convert() unset, xGFANG redeem disabled, Masonry empty, Treasury pre-start; FangRedeem pot balance is 0

BSC router/handlers are unverified (Etherscan V2 free tier unavailable for 56); DataStore/banks/wrapped tokens verified via Sourcify; router ABI reconstructed from the protocol's public SDK
Longbow pool-feed contracts are unverified (mechanism from heimdall decompilation + live structural reads, not source); CL depth approximated by reserve-side notional in the EV math
Scorch core AMM ojh19oja...Corch has no public IDL/source -> swap-pricing E-U cannot be positively excluded (no evidence of a path); IDL is community-published (shank), matches live behavior

P and H-O aggregates overlap by construction (the same assets are both user-recoverable and privileged-at-risk); Meridian P includes ~$1.83M of exchange collateral/LP vault under owner/sequencer control (not directly extractable by them without user signatures on withdrawals)
USD values are point-in-time DefiLlama/marks; unpriced memecoin legs excluded; fork tests run against live state so exact balances drift between runs (structural assertions used)
Out of scope and stated as such: SUBFROST BTC-side signing group; Meridian PerpEngine/Liquidation math (interface-level); Scorch core pricing; Longbow vault economics beyond reads
one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0 live across all 10 fresh-TVL targets (65/65 fork tests): every class path is gated, byte-identical to audited upstreams, or economically closed; the only real defects are dormant conditionals (FangRedeem unfunded $1/FANG pot, NaraUSD <=$270 Keyring-off arb, HertzFlow <=$20 donation mint, Longbow +$654 arithmetic, up v3 M-01 poke) plus P-class key risks (Scorch $4.26M single-key upgrade, SUBFROST FROST group $8.94M, NaraUSD Safe $9.14M, Meridian single-EOA sequencer).
